title: Bug: See-Threepio redirects to the Premiere C-3PO printing
body:
## Defect
[[See-Threepio]] currently redirects to the Premiere [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)]] article, whose printed title/image/set/game text describe Premiere. The independently inspected Reflections II foil prints See-Threepio, the Special Edition expansion symbol and different game text. The earlier non-foil Special Edition publication is not represented accurately by that redirect.

Evidence: https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/See-Threepio ; https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/C-3PO_(See-Threepio) ; https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/See-Threepio_(Reflections_II_Foil) ; https://wiki.swccg.com/wiki/File:Reflections-II-Foil-L-See-Threepio-PSA-photo-135369044-original.jpg . Source comparison and guarded correction receipts: evidence/381/see-threepio-family-*.json.

## Scope / acceptance
- [ ] Find and inspect a correct original non-foil Special Edition scan and primary release/card-list evidence before assigning its separate publication identity.
- [ ] Correct the printed-title article/redirect arrangement, retaining the Premiere C-3PO article and all existing language/text-state/gameplay mappings. Do not invent a GEMP ID.
- [ ] Reconcile reciprocal family navigation and the foil's exact earlier-printing link, preserving existing code annotations and concurrent edits.
- [ ] Verify reviewed/public/style/Cite/visual output and merge source/evidence; handle source preservation honestly under the applicable authorization.

## Existing mitigation
Story381's foil article now labels its link Card family rather than asserting the redirected Premiere target is its exact non-foil predecessor. Foil printed text, original photo and metadata remain correct; the finding is recorded on Talk. This separate original-publication identity task does not block the explicitly authorized regular foil publication. No original non-foil article or rename has been started.

Related: https://github.com/swccg-guild/work/issues/381 . MemoryCoreChatGPT.
